name: uses the coordinate-wise median for one pickup
input: three people whose best L1 center is not an input medoid

name: returns useful locations with a matching cost
test:
p=[(0,0),(1,0),(9,0),(10,0)]
original=list(p)
locations, returned_cost = k_medians(p,2)
assert len(locations)==2 and locations==sorted(locations)
assert all(len(location)==2 for location in locations)
actual_cost=sum(min(abs(x-a)+abs(y-b) for a,b in locations) for x,y in p)
assert returned_cost==actual_cost
assert p==original
print('ok')

name: is deterministic and counts duplicate people separately
input: duplicate coordinates and two pickup locations
test:
p=[(0,0),(0,0),(10,0)]
first=k_medians(p,2)
second=k_medians(p,2)
assert first==second
locations, returned_cost=first
assert len(locations)==2 and locations==sorted(locations)
actual_cost=sum(min(abs(x-a)+abs(y-b) for a,b in locations) for x,y in p)
assert returned_cost==actual_cost
print('ok')

name: accepts list coordinates without mutating them
test:
p=[[0,0],[2,0],[1,3]]
original=[point[:] for point in p]
assert k_medians(p,1) == ([(1,0)],5)
assert p==original
print('ok')
